panel.more.notes: Aero panel / bodywork: no rules load case, but bodywork must stay attached and stable at top speed — the pitch answer below IS aero's 'how close together do the mounting points need to be'. Quick-release is legal and normal here.

options.name: Quarter-turn (Dzus-type), steel
options.note: The classic bodywork fastener; needs a spring + receptacle riveted to the frame side.

options.name: Camloc 1/4-turn, aerospace
options.note: Stronger and more expensive than Dzus; positive retention.

options.name: M5 8.8 bolt + rivnut (Al)
options.note: Tension limited by rivnut thread pull-out in aluminium, not the bolt. Tooled removal — not quick-release.

options.name: M6 8.8 bolt + welded nutplate
options.note: The harness/seat-grade option; nutplate welds to the tube.

options.name: Rubber-buffered pin + lanyard (aero)
options.note: Trailing-edge/secondary retention only — never primary.
